name: KIMLUN
recent: Kimlun 正在推进私下配售集资，并寻求股东在特别股东大会上批准向联营公司 Astaka Kimlun 提供财务援助，以支持 Amora 服务式公寓项目。公司同时公布了季度业绩，营收同比增长但累计净利下滑。
notable: 公司进行私下配售集资，并公布资金使用情况的季度更新。
并发出股东通函及召开特别股东大会寻求批准。
Kii Amber 与 Astaka Kimlun 及 Astaka Capital 签订补充认购及股东协议，修订原有协议。
risks: 私下配售新股可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
公司执行主席 Pang Tin @ Pang Yon Tin 于2026年9月8日及10日分别在公开市场增持股份。
执行董事 Sim Tian Liang 于2026年9月10日在公开市场增持股份。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR 513.7 million，环比增长20.9%，同比增长18.9%；净利为 MYR 22.4 million，环比增长99.0%，但同比下降5.3%。净利率为4.4%，高于上一季度的2.6%。

recent_en: Kimlun is proceeding with a private placement fund raising and seeking shareholder approval at an EGM for financial assistance to its associated company Astaka Kimlun to support the Amora serviced residence project. The company also announced quarterly results with higher revenue year-on-year but lower cumulative net profit.
notable_en: The company is undertaking a private placement fund raising and provided a quarterly update on the utilisation of proceeds.
The company proposed to provide financial assistance to its associated company Astaka Kimlun, issued a circular to shareholders and convened an EGM to seek approval.
Kii Amber entered into a supplemental subscription and shareholders' agreement with Astaka Kimlun and Astaka Capital to amend and restate the original agreement.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
Executive Chairman Pang Tin @ Pang Yon Tin acquired shares in the open market on 8 and 10 September 2026.
Executive Director Sim Tian Liang acquired shares in the open market on 10 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 513.7 million, up 20.9% QoQ and 18.9% YoY; net income was MYR 22.4 million, up 99.0% QoQ but down 5.3% YoY. Net margin was 4.4%, higher than 2.6% in the previous quarter.
